title: Whitley Strieber's uncle worked with General Exon at Wright Field

tellings.quote: talks about his uncle working with very closely with General AXS on at right right Airfield

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber says his uncle worked very closely with a general named Exon at Wright Field, a military airfield in Ohio, around the 1940s. Michels mentions this in passing and ties it to Strieber's book Communion. The connection matters to Michels because it would put Strieber's own family near the people at the base.
